View All Jobs Join Log In For Employers Zalando Jobs Director of CRM Zalando Director of CRM Sorry, this job was removed at 06:30 p.m. (UTC) on Tuesday, Apr 22, 2025 Be an Early Applicant Berlin, DEU In-Office eCommerce • Retail The Role ABOUT PERFORMANCE MARKETING & GROWTH The Performance Marketing & Growth team is responsible for executing Zalando’s customer communication strategy across all performance-driven paid and unpaid marketing channels globally. At the heart of this function sits the CRM Team, which ensures our 52M+ active customers across 26 markets receive impactful and personalized messages that enhance their journey with Zalando. The CRM team is essential to implementing Zalando’s lifecycle engagement and retention strategy, using data-driven insights, automation, and platform excellence to support customers' onboarding, engagement, winback, cross-proposition selling, and loyalty-building. THE ROLE & THE TEAM As the Director of CRM, you will be responsible for the operational and strategic implementation of Zalando’s communication platform. You will lead a cross-functional team of up to 50 FTEs across product, engineering, direct marketing, analytics, and tech consulting. Your mission is to ensure timely, relevant, and high-impact CRM communication across all channels. In this role, you will work collaboratively with leaders across the business, including Markets, Propositions, Product, Engineering, and Applied Science, to translate strategic directives into effective operational delivery. You will be a key member of Zalando’s leadership team. The team includes: Audience Management: This team defines the CRM strategy and the "what", owning the customer engagement plan across different lifecycle stages. Audience Management leads the approach for Activation, Engagement, Up- & Cross-Selling, and Winback management. They determine customer segmentation, channel strategy, and campaign goals that Direct Marketing and other teams execute. Direct Marketing: Responsible for the operational execution of CRM campaigns. This team executes campaigns for Country GMs, Proposition Leaders, and the Loyalty team. Their work is closely aligned with the strategy and targeting set by the Audience Management and Analytics teams, ensuring campaigns are executed effectively and in line with broader business goals. Product & Tech Consulting: The product function is split into two core responsibilities: 1) Focusing on internal platform development, interfacing closely with engineering to define and deliver the underlying CRM infrastructure. This team also supports setting up new channels and templates. 2) Ensuring platform features and services are fully operational, working in tight alignment with engineering to maintain system performance and reliability. Engineering: Builds and maintains the core infrastructure of the communication platform. This team ensures technical scalability, platform stability, and system excellence. Analytics: Drives reporting and targeting. This team plays a central role in defining lifecycle campaigns through data insights, segmentation logic, and campaign performance measurement. WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING) Define a cohesive product strategy and manage both first-party and third-party CRM applications to meet evolving business needs. Lead, inspire, and grow a cross-functional team of leaders across product, engineering, analytics, and direct marketing, providing clear vision and direction. Build strong, collaborative relationships with key stakeholders such as Country GMs, Proposition Leaders, and Product & Tech stakeholders, to ensure the CRM platform supports their commercial goals. Act as a trusted and valued senior leader within the wider Markets organization and beyond, fostering a culture of openness, purpose-first collaboration, and operational excellence. Champion measurement and experimentation using causal inference and other advanced analytics approaches to continuously optimize CRM impact. Explore new engagement channels beyond emails and push notifications, including in-app messaging and notification capabilities, to innovate the customer experience. Support the engineering leadership in ensuring platform excellence, technical scalability, and system stability. WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF You have a proven track record of building and maintaining CRM products for B2C companies, including the successful delivery of large-scale, data-intensive marketing platforms that support the commercial roadmap and strategic objectives of the business. You have led large cross-functional teams, ideally covering both technical (engineering/product) and marketing (campaign execution) functions. You have a strong strategic and technical mindset, capable of balancing operational execution with innovation and stakeholder engagement. You are experienced working with complex CRM tech stacks, such as Braze or equivalent CRM tools. You are data-driven, with a solid understanding of analytics, experimentation, and customer segmentation. You are passionate about building loyal customer relationships, driving engagement, and testing new ways to interact with customers across channels. OUR OFFER Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer. The Company HQ: Berlin 10,000 Employees Year Founded: 2008 What We Do Welcome to Zalando. Here’s some key info about us: Our position and vision: - We’re Europe’s leading online platform for fashion and lifestyle - Founded in Berlin in 2008, we bring head-to-toe fashion to more than 50 million active customers in 25 markets; offering clothes, footwear, accessories, and beauty - Our vision is to become The Starting Point For Fashion. Our offering: - Our assortment of international brands ranges from world-famous names to local labels - Our platform is a one-stop fashion destination for inspiration, innovation, and interaction - As Europe’s most fashionable tech company, we work hard to find digital solutions for every aspect of the fashion journey: for our customers, partners, and friends of our brand. - Our logistics network with 12 centrally located fulfillment centers allows us to efficiently serve our customers throughout Europe, supported by warehouses in Italy, France, Poland, and Sweden with a focus on local customer needs. Our beliefs: - Our ambition is to combine our passion for self-expression through fashion with our unwavering commitments to sustainability and D&I - We believe that our integration of fashion, operations, and online technology gives us the capability to deliver a compelling value proposition to both our customers and fashion brand partners.
